Dialogue.Page: Oh me oh my! The sun is loosing stability! I can see it on my telescope! If nothing is done about this, we are toast!
This North pole area serves both as our observatory and our radio communications centre. You know, for communiating with objects in space, such as our sun monitoring probe.
If there are any other planets out there with the right radio equipment close enough, maybe we could call them for help...
I heard someone was working on some time travel project down on the South pole. Maybe that could buy us the time we need to figure out this sun situation...?
I heard someone was working on a sun stabilisation device on the equator. Though it sounds like it is only <color=orange>half</color> as powerful as it would need to be to save the sun...
